attributes.name: reventless.spec
attributes.summary: Marks a spec file: injects its name, Id and moduleUrl, and runs the field passes.

attributes.name: reventless.behavior
attributes.summary: Marks a behavior file: opens its spec and injects Spec and moduleUrl.

attributes.name: reventless.projection
attributes.summary: Marks a state view's projection file: opens its spec and injects Spec and moduleUrl.

attributes.name: reventless.automation
attributes.summary: Marks an automation file: its process and per-source mappings, with the spec opened.

attributes.name: reventless.translation
attributes.summary: Marks a translation file: opens its spec and injects Spec and moduleUrl.

attributes.name: reventless.mappings
attributes.summary: Marks a file of per-source mappings (`_Mappings` or `_Projections`) and injects their functor.

attributes.name: reventless.extension
attributes.summary: Marks an extension file, and derives the table of events it routes to commands.

attributes.name: reventless.task
attributes.summary: Marks a task file: injects its name and moduleUrl.

attributes.name: reventless.dcbTags
attributes.summary: Infers DCB tags in a file outside a slice folder.

attributes.name: reventless.async
attributes.summary: Dispatches this aggregate's or slice's commands asynchronously: a command answers pending.

attributes.name: reventless.systemCallable
attributes.summary: Lets a deploy-time system caller (IAM) call this component's GraphQL fields.

attributes.name: reventless.gwt
attributes.summary: Marks a GWT test file: opens its spec and includes the matching test DSL.

attributes.name: reventless.visibility
attributes.summary: Hides a read model or state view from the generated UI (`Internal`); the default is `Public`.

attributes.name: reventless.authorize
attributes.summary: Who may call this component, in place of the default: any signed-in user.

attributes.name: reventless.consistency
attributes.summary: How a state-change slice reads its history before deciding; the default escalates on retry.

attributes.name: reventless.snapshots
attributes.summary: Snapshots this aggregate's state every N events.

attributes.name: reventless.examples
attributes.summary: Marks a module of named example values that scenarios refer to.

attributes.name: reventless.delegate
attributes.summary: Treats this module as a Delegate outside an extension-point or extension file.

attributes.name: reventless.projections
attributes.summary: Removed. Move the mappings into a `_Projections.res` file marked `@@reventless.mappings`.

attributes.name: noApi
attributes.summary: Keeps this command, or every command of the type, off the GraphQL and MCP APIs.

attributes.name: authorize
attributes.summary: Who may issue this one command, in place of the file's rule.

attributes.name: live
attributes.summary: Whether the view offers live updates by default.

attributes.name: namedWhenRetired
attributes.summary: A retired row still answers the reference door with its name.

attributes.name: transition
attributes.summary: Removed. Declare the command's edge in a `commandTransition` switch.

attributes.name: allowedStates
attributes.summary: Removed. Declare the from-set in a `commandTransition` switch.

attributes.name: targetState
attributes.summary: Removed. Declare the target in a `commandTransition` switch.

attributes.name: partitionTag
attributes.summary: The id this event is stored under, where the slice's partition cannot be inferred.

attributes.name: crossPartition
attributes.summary: A tag whose decision read spans every partition carrying it.

attributes.name: dcbTag
attributes.summary: Tags a field that is not named `*Id`; the argument sets the tag key.

attributes.name: compositePartitionTag
attributes.summary: One segment of a partition key made of several fields, joined in declaration order.

attributes.name: noDcbTag
attributes.summary: This `*Id` field is payload, not a DCB tag.

attributes.name: noTag
attributes.summary: Renamed. Use `@noDcbTag`.

attributes.name: ref
attributes.summary: This field holds the id of another entity.

attributes.name: storageRef
attributes.summary: The object store the file this field refers to is kept in.

attributes.name: offload
attributes.summary: A value kept in an object store and carried by reference when large, inline when small.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.summary: The caller a row or command belongs to: set from the caller on write, and narrowing reads.

attributes.name: sensitive
attributes.summary: A value that must not be put into content a person receives.

attributes.name: default
attributes.summary: The value a generated form opens this field on.

attributes.name: displayName
attributes.summary: Part of the row's display name, with the other fields marked; the argument is the separator.

attributes.name: id
attributes.summary: The row's partition key.

attributes.name: compositeId
attributes.summary: One segment of a partition key made of several fields; the argument is the separator.

attributes.name: subId
attributes.summary: The row's sort key.

attributes.name: compositeSubId
attributes.summary: One segment of a sort key made of several fields; the argument is the separator.

attributes.name: index
attributes.summary: A key of a secondary index; the argument names it, or sets its projection.

attributes.name: indexSubId
attributes.summary: The sort key of the named secondary index.

attributes.name: resolves
attributes.summary: Adds a field resolving this id to a row of another view of the plugin.

attributes.name: resolvesMany
attributes.summary: Adds a field resolving these ids to rows of another view of the plugin.

attributes.name: lifecycle
attributes.summary: The field a record's lifecycle lives in.

attributes.name: status
attributes.summary: Renamed. Use `@lifecycle`.

attributes.name: groupBy
attributes.summary: The field a list view sections its rows by.

attributes.name: retired
attributes.summary: The flag, or the lifecycle state, that withdraws a row from ordinary reads.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.summary: Left out of summary and list views.

attributes.name: summary
attributes.summary: Always shown in summary and list views.

attributes.name: internal
attributes.summary: Left out of the generated GraphQL type; still stored.

attributes.name: drillTarget
attributes.summary: The view a row drills down into.

attributes.name: collapsed
attributes.summary: Shown collapsed in a hierarchical view.

attributes.name: scan
attributes.summary: Lets a field without an index be filtered on the server.

attributes.name: scanSort
attributes.summary: Lets a field without an index be sorted on the server.

attributes.name: semantic
attributes.summary: What the value means, for how it is shown.

attributes.name: metric
attributes.summary: A dashboard metric over this field.
